entry_lifecycle.catalyst_logic: Pereira's still-building euro-area inflation pressure is the standing euro support, and US GDP and PCE on 25 Nov can confirm the expansion the euro is failing to price.
entry_lifecycle.realization_logic: The long is realized if EURUSD lifts off the 1.0992 first-percentile area as the defensive dollar premium fades while equities and crude keep signaling expansion.

entry_rationale: March 2027 SOFR already prices the hike path from 3.90 effective toward 4.29 by December and a 4.76 two-year, so paying it is inferior. EURUSD at the first percentile of the past year is the cleaner pro-growth expression while equities and Brent still show an expansion and euro-area inflation pressure is still building.
entry_thesis: Buy 15 million dollars of EURUSD. The euro at 1.0992 is the first percentile of its one-year range after a five-day decline, while the Nasdaq near 23,879, the Dow near 49,097 and Brent near 92 still show an intact expansion, and euro-area inflation pressure is still building. The risk is that the haven bid, with gold near 3,686 and VIX near 24.6, extends and takes the euro through this spot.

events.rationale: March 2027 SOFR already prices the hike path from 3.90 effective toward 4.29 by December and a 4.76 two-year, so paying it is inferior. EURUSD at the first percentile of the past year is the cleaner pro-growth expression while equities and Brent still show an expansion and euro-area inflation pressure is still building.

invalidation: A closing break of EURUSD below 1.0992, with gold still elevated and VIX still above the mid-20s, would show the defensive dollar bid is a trend rather than a discount of growth.
